versions.content: Specification of the value of SdgClass . extendsMetaClass and SdgAbstractForeignReference . destMetaClass The string entered as the value of SdgClass . extendsMetaClass and SdgAbstractForeignReference . destMetaClass shall follow the format of a name of a M2 class as defined in the XML schema and the referenced class needs to be derived (directly or indirectly) from Referrable .
